nostr.Event.UnmarshalJSON: hand-tuned easyjson lexer that hex-decodes id/pubkey/sig straight into [32]byte/[64]byte arrays (no strings for them), Kind is uint16. An all-zero array means absent in this library (its encoder omits zero id/pubkey/sig; its decoder leaves them zero unless the hex is exactly 64/128 chars), so the digest glue maps zero back to an empty string (the corpus has unsigned rumors whose sig is empty). Pinned to the last commit whose go.mod allows Go 1.24 (decoder identical to HEAD except unknown-field skipping)
